steps.name: reads the sample on the CPU
steps.check: (() => { const text = [...document.querySelectorAll('#lines li:not(.empty)')].map((li) => li.firstChild.textContent).join('\n'); return text.includes('Markov Entropy Decomposition') && [...document.querySelectorAll('#lines li:not(.empty)')].length >= 40 ? null : `read ${[...document.querySelectorAll('#lines li:not(.empty)')].length} lines: ${text.slice(0, 200)}`; })()

steps.run: (() => { const r = document.getElementById('runtime'); r.value = 'wgpu'; r.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); })()
